name: The Lost Boy: A Lost Silver Dating Sim
source:
You find yourself in Lavender Town. A man sneaks up behind you.

He had good intentions, but now he regrets scaring you. If you make the right choice, you’ll progress in the game.

What will you choose?

[From [url=https://mq-why.itch.io/a-lost-silver-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]

你发现自己身处紫苑镇。一个男人悄悄走到了你的身后。

他原本并无恶意，如今正为吓到了你而懊悔不已。只要作出正确的选择，你便能继续推进剧情。

你将如何抉择？
